mapper.sql: select user.id, user.mobile, user.email, user.name, user.username, user.account, user.status, user.create_time, sr.access, sr.role_name, si.image from sys_user user left join sys_user_role sur on user.id = sur.user_id left join sys_role sr on sur.id = sr.id left join sys_image si on user.image_id = si.id order by sr.access, user.id
mapper.select: select su.id, su.mobile, su.email, su.name, su.username, su.account, su.status, su.create_time, su.sex, sr.access, sr.role_name, sr.id as role_id from sys_user su left join sys_user_role sur on su.id = sur.user_id left join sys_role sr on sr.id = sur.role_id order by sr.access, su.id
select c.create_time as year, count(*) as count from (select date_format(create_time, '%Y') create_time FROM `sys_user`) c group by c.create_time order by c.create_time
